title.zh: 把二维数值域写成球的线性像
title.en: Express the two-dimensional numerical range as an image of a ball

given.zh: 先取 A:ℂ²→ℂ²。对单位向量 x=(x₀,x₁)，令 b(x)=(2 Re(x̄₀x₁),2 Im(x̄₀x₁),|x₀|²−|x₁|²)。
given.en: First take A:ℂ²→ℂ². For a unit vector x=(x₀,x₁), set b(x)=(2 Re(x̄₀x₁),2 Im(x̄₀x₁),|x₀|²−|x₁|²).

claim.zh: 存在 c∈ℂ 和实线性 F:ℝ³→ℂ，使 W(A)=c+F(S²)=c+F(B³)，因此 W(A) 凸。
claim.en: There are c∈ℂ and a real linear F:ℝ³→ℂ with W(A)=c+F(S²)=c+F(B³), so W(A) is convex.

statement.zh: c=(A₀₀+A₁₁)/2；F(u)=u₁(A₀₁+A₁₀)/2+iu₂(A₀₁−A₁₀)/2+u₃(A₀₀−A₁₁)/2。
statement.en: c=(A₀₀+A₁₁)/2; F(u)=u₁(A₀₁+A₁₀)/2+iu₂(A₀₁−A₁₀)/2+u₃(A₀₀−A₁₁)/2.

reason.zh: 将 ⟨x,Ax⟩ 的两个对角项按和、差重组，两个非对角项按实部、虚部重组，得到 c+F(b(x))。
reason.en: Regroup the diagonal terms of ⟨x,Ax⟩ into their sum and difference, and the off-diagonal terms into real and imaginary parts, to obtain c+F(b(x)).

statement.zh: ‖b(x)‖²=4|x₀|²|x₁|²+(|x₀|²−|x₁|²)²=(|x₀|²+|x₁|²)²=1。
statement.en: ‖b(x)‖²=4|x₀|²|x₁|²+(|x₀|²−|x₁|²)²=(|x₀|²+|x₁|²)²=1.

reason.zh: 第一等式合并复数乘积的实、虚部平方；最后一步使用 x 的单位范数。因而每个数值域点来自 S²。
reason.en: The first equality combines the squared real and imaginary parts of the complex product. The unit norm of x gives the last equality, placing every numerical-range value in the sphere image.

statement.zh: 对 u∈S²，若 u₃>−1，取 x₀=√((1+u₃)/2)、x₁=(u₁+iu₂)/(2x₀)；若 u₃=−1，取 x=(0,1)。
statement.en: For u∈S² with u₃>−1, take x₀=√((1+u₃)/2) and x₁=(u₁+iu₂)/(2x₀); for u₃=−1, take x=(0,1).

reason.zh: 由 u₁²+u₂²=1−u₃² 逐项验证 ‖x‖=1 和 b(x)=u，得到反向包含 W(A)=c+F(S²)。
reason.en: Use u₁²+u₂²=1−u₃² to check ‖x‖=1 and b(x)=u coordinate by coordinate. This proves the reverse inclusion and W(A)=c+F(S²).

statement.zh: 选 0≠k∈ker F。对 ‖n‖≤1，可取 t 使 ‖n+tk‖=1，且 F(n+tk)=F(n)。
statement.en: Choose 0≠k∈ker F. For ‖n‖≤1, choose t with ‖n+tk‖=1; then F(n+tk)=F(n).

reason.zh: F 的实定义域维数为 3、值域维数至多为 2，所以核非零。沿核直线的范数连续且无界，必经过单位球面。
reason.en: The real domain dimension is three and the image dimension is at most two, so the kernel is nonzero. Norm along this kernel line is continuous and unbounded, hence reaches the unit sphere.

statement.zh: c+F(S²)=c+F(B³)；因此连接任意两个数值域点的整条线段仍在 W(A) 内。
statement.en: c+F(S²)=c+F(B³), so the full segment between any two numerical-range points remains in W(A).

reason.zh: 球 B³ 凸，实线性映射与平移都保持凸组合。球面像与球像相等才使这个凸性结论适用于数值域。
reason.en: The ball is convex, and real linear maps and translation preserve convex combinations. Equality of the sphere and ball images is what transfers this convexity to W(A).

title.zh: 得到紧凸闭包，并把谱装入其中
title.en: Obtain a compact convex closure containing the spectrum

given.zh: H 为完备复 Hilbert 空间，A 为有界线性算子。二维凸性已经成立。
given.en: Let H be a complete complex Hilbert space and A a bounded linear operator. The two-dimensional convexity result is available.

claim.zh: K=闭包 W(A) 紧且凸，并且 σ(A)⊆K。
claim.en: K=closure W(A) is compact and convex, and σ(A)⊆K.

statement.zh: 对单位向量 x,y，在 span{x,y} 的至多二维压缩中得到两点间的整条数值域线段。
statement.en: For unit x,y, the compression to span{x,y}, of dimension at most two, supplies the numerical-range segment between their values.

reason.zh: 压缩不改变该子空间中向量的 ⟨u,Au⟩；将二维结论嵌回 H 得到 W(A) 凸，取闭包后仍凸。
reason.en: Compression preserves ⟨u,Au⟩ for vectors in the subspace. Embed the two-dimensional result back into H to obtain convex W(A), and then take its convex closure.

statement.zh: |⟨x,Ax⟩|≤‖x‖‖Ax‖≤‖A‖；故 K 是 ℂ 中的有界闭集，因而紧。
statement.en: |⟨x,Ax⟩|≤‖x‖‖Ax‖≤‖A‖; thus K is closed and bounded in ℂ and hence compact.

reason.zh: 此处 ‖x‖=1；闭包保持这条非严格界，复平面的有限实维数再把闭且有界转成紧。
reason.en: Here ‖x‖=1. Closure retains the non-strict bound, and the finite real dimension of the complex plane makes closed bounded sets compact.

statement.zh: z∉K 时令 ε=dist(z,W(A))>0、B=zI−A。则 ε‖x‖²≤|⟨x,Bx⟩|≤‖x‖‖Bx‖。
statement.en: For z∉K put ε=dist(z,W(A))>0 and B=zI−A. Then ε‖x‖²≤|⟨x,Bx⟩|≤‖x‖‖Bx‖.

reason.zh: 非零 x 可归一化为 u=x/‖x‖，而 ⟨u,Bu⟩=z−⟨u,Au⟩ 距零至少 ε；乘回 ‖x‖² 即得左界。零向量直接满足。
reason.en: Normalize nonzero x to u=x/‖x‖. Since ⟨u,Bu⟩=z−⟨u,Au⟩ has modulus at least ε, rescaling gives the lower bound; x=0 satisfies it directly.

statement.zh: ‖Bx‖≥ε‖x‖，同样 ‖B*x‖≥ε‖x‖；因此 ran B 闭且 (ran B)⊥=ker B*={0}。
statement.en: ‖Bx‖≥ε‖x‖ and likewise ‖B*x‖≥ε‖x‖; hence ran B is closed and (ran B)⊥=ker B*={0}.

reason.zh: 强制下界使 B 单射，并使任何像中的 Cauchy 序列具有原像 Cauchy 序列，故值域闭；伴随内积与原内积互为共轭，故它也有同一下界。
reason.en: The lower bound makes B injective and forces preimages of Cauchy sequences in its range to be Cauchy, proving closed range. The adjoint inner product is the conjugate of the original one, giving the same bound for B*.

statement.zh: ran B=H，且 ‖B⁻¹‖≤1/ε；所以 z∉σ(A)，即 σ(A)⊆K。
statement.en: ran B=H and ‖B⁻¹‖≤1/ε; thus z∉σ(A), proving σ(A)⊆K.

reason.zh: 零正交补使闭值域稠密，于是 B 满射并有有界逆。若 H 只有零向量，则数值域和谱都为空，单独闭合这个分支。
reason.en: Zero orthogonal complement makes the closed range dense and hence all of H, yielding a bounded inverse. If H is the zero space, both the numerical range and spectrum are empty, closing that branch separately.

title.zh: 收集有限条 Krylov 轨道

given.zh: 给定次数 d 的矩阵多项式及代数张量 ξ∈H⊗ℂᵐ。把 ξ 写成有限和 Σₛ xₛ⊗fₛ。此步不要求 H 完备。
given.en: Fix a matrix polynomial of degree d and an algebraic tensor ξ∈H⊗ℂᵐ. Write ξ as a finite sum Σₛ xₛ⊗fₛ. Completeness of H is not needed here.

claim.zh: E=span{Aʲxₛ : s∈S, 0≤j≤d} 有限维，并同时包含所有 xₛ 及求值需要的中间向量。
claim.en: E=span{Aʲxₛ : s∈S, 0≤j≤d} is finite dimensional and contains every xₛ and every intermediate vector needed for evaluation.

statement.zh: ξ=Σₛ∈S xₛ⊗fₛ，其中 S 有限；生成向量以 (s,j)∈S×{0,…,d} 编号。
statement.en: Write ξ=Σₛ∈S xₛ⊗fₛ with finite S; index the generating vectors by (s,j)∈S×{0,…,d}.

reason.zh: 代数张量按定义由有限个纯张量相加得到，因此这里无须用无穷级数近似 ξ。
reason.en: An algebraic tensor is a finite sum of pure tensors, so no infinite-series approximation of ξ is needed.

statement.zh: E=span{Aʲxₛ}，dim E≤|S|(d+1)<∞。
statement.en: E=span{Aʲxₛ}, with dim E≤|S|(d+1)<∞.

reason.zh: 生成元集合是有限指标集的像；有限个向量的线性包至多具有生成元数目的维数。
reason.en: The generators are the image of a finite index set, and their span has dimension no greater than their number.

statement.zh: xₛ=A⁰xₛ∈E，且 Aʲxₛ∈E 对每个 0≤j≤d 都成立。
statement.en: xₛ=A⁰xₛ∈E, and Aʲxₛ∈E for every 0≤j≤d.

reason.zh: 每个所需中间向量本身就是生成元。这保证有限次数的轨道被保存，并不要求整个 E 在 A 下不变。
reason.en: Every required intermediate vector is itself a generator. This retains the finite orbit segments without asserting that all of E is invariant under A.

title.zh: 逐次消去压缩中的投影
title.en: Remove the projections along each required orbit

given.zh: E 包含每个 Aʲxₛ，0≤j≤d。令 A_E=P_E A|E，并把 η 送入完成后的张量空间。
given.en: E contains Aʲxₛ for 0≤j≤d. Let A_E=P_E A|E and view η in the completed tensor product.

claim.zh: J_Eη=ξ，且 J_E(P(A_E)η)=P(A)ξ；这里是给定 ξ 上的精确相等。
claim.en: J_Eη=ξ and J_E(P(A_E)η)=P(A)ξ: these are exact equalities on the given ξ.

statement.zh: 设 x̃ₛ 是 xₛ 在 E 中的元素，η=Σₛ x̃ₛ⊗fₛ；由 J_E 的定义，J_Eη=Σₛxₛ⊗fₛ=ξ。
statement.en: Regard xₛ as x̃ₛ∈E and put η=Σₛx̃ₛ⊗fₛ. By definition, J_Eη=Σₛxₛ⊗fₛ=ξ.

reason.zh: 包含映射在纯张量上仅把 E 中的向量还原为 H 中同一个向量，并保持有限和。
reason.en: On pure tensors, the inclusion regards a vector of E as the same vector of H, and it preserves finite sums.

statement.zh: 若 j<d 且 A_Eʲx̃ₛ 对应 Aʲxₛ，则 A_Eʲ⁺¹x̃ₛ=P_E(Aʲ⁺¹xₛ)=Aʲ⁺¹xₛ。
statement.en: If j<d and A_Eʲx̃ₛ corresponds to Aʲxₛ, then A_Eʲ⁺¹x̃ₛ=P_E(Aʲ⁺¹xₛ)=Aʲ⁺¹xₛ.

reason.zh: j+1≤d 使 Aʲ⁺¹xₛ 仍在 E 内，正交投影在 E 上恒等；结合 j=0 的起点即可归纳到 d。
reason.en: Since j+1≤d, the next orbit vector belongs to E and projection fixes it. Together with j=0, this proves agreement by induction through d.

statement.zh: J_E[(A_Eʲ⊗Bⱼ)(x̃ₛ⊗fₛ)]=Aʲxₛ⊗Bⱼfₛ。
statement.en: J_E[(A_Eʲ⊗Bⱼ)(x̃ₛ⊗fₛ)]=Aʲxₛ⊗Bⱼfₛ.

reason.zh: 张量算子分别作用于两个因子；上一行保证第一个因子的压缩幂正好等于原算子的幂。
reason.en: A tensor operator acts on the two factors separately, and the preceding equality identifies the compressed power on the first factor.

statement.zh: J_E P(A_E)η=ΣⱼΣₛ Aʲxₛ⊗Bⱼfₛ=P(A)ξ。
statement.en: J_E P(A_E)η=ΣⱼΣₛ Aʲxₛ⊗Bⱼfₛ=P(A)ξ.

reason.zh: 将多项式的有限项和 η 的有限和逐项展开，再交换有限求和与线性包含，得到给定 ξ 上的精确等式。
reason.en: Expand the finite polynomial and tensor sums, then move their finite sums through the linear inclusion. This gives exact equality on the specified ξ.

title.zh: 用谱映射证明分母算子可逆
title.en: Use spectral mapping to invert the denominator operator

given.zh: H 非平凡，R 是有理函数矩阵，且 K⊆poleFreeSet(R)：每个分母 qᵢⱼ 在 K 上都不为零。
given.en: Assume H is nontrivial and R is a rational matrix whose denominators qᵢⱼ are nonzero throughout K.

claim.zh: 对每个矩阵指标 i,j，qᵢⱼ(A) 是可逆算子。
claim.en: For every i,j, the operator qᵢⱼ(A) is invertible.

statement.zh: 若 z∈σ(A)，则 z∈K，故每个分母 qᵢⱼ(z)≠0。
statement.en: If z∈σ(A), then z∈K, so every denominator qᵢⱼ(z) is nonzero.

reason.zh: 谱包含关系使 K 上的无极点假设可直接用于谱中的每个点。
reason.en: Spectral inclusion lets the pole-free assumption on K apply to every spectral point.

statement.zh: σ(qᵢⱼ(A))={qᵢⱼ(z):z∈σ(A)}，所以 0∉σ(qᵢⱼ(A))。
statement.en: σ(qᵢⱼ(A))={qᵢⱼ(z):z∈σ(A)}, hence 0∉σ(qᵢⱼ(A)).

reason.zh: 多项式谱映射把新算子的谱点逐个写成旧谱点的分母值，而上一行已排除了值零。
reason.en: Polynomial spectral mapping expresses each new spectral point as a denominator value on the old spectrum, and the preceding line excludes zero.

statement.zh: IsUnit(qᵢⱼ(A))；因此有理求值中的 qᵢⱼ(A)⁻¹ 是该分母的真正逆。
statement.en: IsUnit(qᵢⱼ(A)); the inverse qᵢⱼ(A)⁻¹ in rational evaluation is therefore a genuine inverse.

reason.zh: 在算子代数中，零不在谱内等价于可逆。此处仍沿用给定的非平凡 H 假设。
reason.en: In the operator algebra, exclusion of zero from the spectrum is equivalent to invertibility. The stated nontriviality assumption on H remains in force.

title.zh: 在零空间上闭合退化情况

given.zh: 现在假设 H 只有零向量。normSup 对空集按定义取 0。
given.en: Now assume H contains only the zero vector. By definition, normSup on the empty set is 0.

claim.zh: W(A)=∅；各张量放大空间也只有零向量；多项式、全纯及有理求值均为 0，因此相应的 ‖求值‖≤2·normSup(W(A),F) 都化为 0≤0。
claim.en: W(A)=∅, every amplified space is trivial, and the polynomial, holomorphic and rational evaluations are all 0. Their bounds ‖evaluation‖≤2·normSup(W(A),F) therefore reduce to 0≤0.

statement.zh: H={0} ⇒ 不存在 ‖x‖=1 的向量 ⇒ W(A)=∅，normSup(W(A),F)=0。
statement.en: H={0} implies there is no unit vector, hence W(A)=∅ and normSup(W(A),F)=0.

reason.zh: 唯一向量的范数是零；normSup 对空集取零是本题给定的定义。
reason.en: The unique vector has norm zero, and the definition in this problem assigns zero to normSup on the empty set.

statement.zh: H⊗ℂᵐ={0}，其完备化也为 {0}；这个空间上的每个求值算子等于 0。
statement.en: H⊗ℂᵐ={0} and its completion is also {0}; every evaluation operator on this space is zero.

reason.zh: 纯张量的 H 因子都为零，张量和与完成空间仍只有一个元素，因此任意两个线性算子逐点相同。
reason.en: Every pure tensor has zero H factor, so the tensor space and its completion each have one element. Any two linear operators on it therefore agree pointwise.

reason.zh: 把零算子及空集上的 normSup 代入多项式、全纯、有理三类结论，即得到零空间分支的全部范数界。
reason.en: Substitute the zero operator and the empty-set normSup into the polynomial, holomorphic and rational conclusions to obtain all bounds in this zero-space branch.
